about: GTA 6 Ultimate Edition, Chapter 1 warning (Delta). Rockstar's editions page and the PS/Xbox store pages list Jason's Safehouse Vehicles (an 'Army fatigue-tinged Dinka Enduro motorcycle or Crest Kayak') and the 'Ganado Retro Build' modkit for 'Jason's well-worn Vapid Ganado low-riding pickup', and say nothing about chapters (read 2026-11-20). VGC's guide (Jordan Middler, 2026-11-18): safehouse vehicles 'can only be accessed in Chapter 1'; Ganado Retro Build 'available only in Chapter 1, after the Just A Scratch mission'. Vice, Red Bull, outputlag agree. Jason's car is lost at the end of Chapter 1: Game Rant (Tom Bowen, 2026-11-20) and TheGamer (Sam Woods, 2026-11-20). 'Impounded' (the inspiration TikTok's word) is NOT supported for Jason's pickup and is not used. Inspiration: TikTok by @cnnstarr, topic only, no footage (burned-in logo). Sources in BRIEF.md.
